jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist (AI First)
locations_derived: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
About the Role
As a Technical Support Specialist at DataSnipper, you'll be a key player on our AI-first support team, helping customers resolve complex technical issues while actively shaping how we scale and improve our support systems.
This isn't a traditional support role. You'll work hands-on with our agentic AI infrastructure, helping to improve its resolution rate and answer quality, while independently handling escalated tickets that require real technical depth - think log analysis, API debugging, and coordinating with Engineering on code-level investigations.
Beyond the day-to-day, you'll help build the foundation that makes our team better: maintaining our technical knowledge base, identifying recurring issue patterns to feed back into Product and Engineering, and contributing to the onboarding and development of new team members.
You'll be joining a small, fast-moving global team based across Amsterdam, New York, and Kuala Lumpur, where curiosity, ownership, and a bias for systemic thinking are as valued as technical ability.
About DataSnipper 🚀
Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.
Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.
We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.
About the Team
We're an AI-first support team that thrives on adopting new technologies, building our own tooling, digging into complex technical issues and analysis, and working on reporting to understand where we can improve. We're a small, fast-moving team with teammates across the globe based in Amsterdam, New York, and Kuala Lumpur.
What You Will Do:
Work closely with our agentic AI infrastructure to continuously improve its resolution rate and the quality of the answers it produces
Independently resolve escalated technical support tickets, diagnosing root causes using logs, scripts, and internal tooling, and coordinating with Engineering for code-level investigation when needed
Partner with Customer Success and Engineering to drive timely resolution of customer-impacting bugs and incidents
Maintain and improve the technical knowledge base, creating troubleshooting guides that reduce repeat issues.
Track recurring issues, feeding patterns into Product and Engineering to drive systemic improvements
Contribute to onboarding and training of new support team members
What You Bring:
2–4 years of experience in a technical support or application support role in a B2B SaaS environment
Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills, comfortable working with logs, APIs, and browser developer tools
Strong all-round technical aptitude across computers, software, and AI, able to navigate systems such as Windows and Azure, run basic networking checks, inspect the registry, and quickly pick up new software and technical concepts to get things done in unfamiliar environments
Solid understanding of SaaS product architecture concepts (APIs, integrations, data flows)
Experience with CRM and ticketing systems such as Intercom, Zendesk, Jira, or similar
AI tool fluency, able to use AI to increase productivity, analyze data, and actively contribute to support AI agent improvement loops
Adaptability to flex across priorities as needed, from strategy and AI improvement work to hands-on ticket crunching during peak-volume periods
Committed, self-driven attitude with strong ownership, urgency, and follow-through, able to work independently, manage multiple open tickets, and prioritize effectively
Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal, for customer-facing interactions
Proficient in English, both spoken and written
Experience with Excel, audit tools, or financial software is a strong plus
Open-minded and adaptive to changing conditions, always looking for opportunities to scale our systems rather than just working through the queue


What we offer
Excellent salary + stock participation plan
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive medical and dental coverage
401K match
Paid parental leave
Company-sponsored lunch
Hybrid mode of work (at least 3 days onsite in our New York City office)
Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands
Make an impact by disrupting the finance industry with us
A flexible and growing organization with lots of opportunities to learn and develop
International working environment, with a team of friendly and driven colleagues
Access to OpenUp and Talkspace, the mental health and wellness platform
Multiple social activities for team building 🤩
This role is your opportunity to live out our team's values, owning the moment to drive consistent success for your customers and excellence in everything you do. If this sounds appealing to you, we'd love to speak with you!

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern - Client Management Account Analyst, US
locations_derived: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income. With our launch in 1971 in Newport Beach, California, PIMCO introduced investors to a total return approach to fixed income investing. In the 50+ years since, we have worked relentlessly to help millions of investors pursue their objectives – regardless of shifting marketing conditions. As active investors, our goal is not just to find opportunities, but to create them. To this end, we remain firmly committed to the pursuit of our mission: delivering superior investment returns, solutions, and service to our clients.
Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.
2027 Summer Internship – Client Management Account Analyst, US 
Internship positions are located at PIMCO’s Newport Beach, CA Headquarters, Austin, TX, and New York, NY. 
Are you ready to jump-start your career in finance while making real impact? We welcome applicants who: 
Are an undergraduate currently pursuing a degree with an expected graduation date of December 2027 – June 2028 
Must be able to begin full-time employment at a PIMCO office between January 2028 – August 2028 
Have a minimum 3.2 cumulative collegiate grade point average on a 4.0 scale (or the equivalent) at an accredited 4-year college or university 
Are business proficient in English 
All majors encouraged to apply 
You’ll thrive here as an Account Analyst intern if you: 
Have a strong interest in the financial markets, macroeconomics, and investment finance 
Demonstrate analytical thinking, attention to detail, and intellectual curiosity 
Communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing 
Build strong relationships and enjoy collaborating across teams 
Take initiative, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced environment 
Bring professionalism, accountability, humility, and sound judgment to your work 
Demonstrate proficiency with Microsoft Excel and an interest in using data, automation, and AI-enabled tools to solve problems and improve outcomes 
See yourself as an Account Analyst: 
Are you excited about the world of investment finance and eager to learn how PIMCO delivers best-in-class service to clients? As an Account Analyst intern, you’ll work alongside Account Associates and broader client servicing teams to support timely, high-quality service across a range of investment strategies. You’ll gain exposure to economic and market analysis, portfolio structures, performance attribution, client reporting, and the ways data, automation, and AI-enabled tools help improve workflows and generate insights. Throughout the summer, you’ll build relationships across teams, strengthen your analytical and communication skills, and gain a strong foundation for a potential long-term career in client management, product strategy, or other client-facing roles. 
While our eligibility requirements are not flexible, we encourage you to apply even if you do not possess 100% of the desired skills outlined above. 
The PIMCO Internship Experience: 
The PIMCO Internship is a 10-week program that runs from early June to mid-August, with the expectation that you will be available for the full duration of the program 
During Week 1, you’ll participate in PIMCO Fundamentals Training, providing you with the skills, knowledge, and relationships that will prepare you for success 
Alongside your colleagues, participate in PIMCO's Global Month of Volunteering, developed to heighten the impact of our employees' worldwide volunteer efforts 
Join us for a variety of cross-divisional education, networking & social events! 
Your supervisor, peer mentor, senior leaders and team offer guidance and mentorship throughout the summer 
You will build future-ready skills by using AI-powered tools from day one, supported by training that strengthens critical thinking, analytical capabilities, and professional judgment. 
You’ll receive feedback at mid- and end-of-summer as part of a formal review process to keep you on the path to meeting your summer goals 
Want to learn more? Hear about The PIMCO Internship Experience from past interns 
As a PIMCO intern, you’ll receive competitive compensation, along with a transition bonus to help with relocation to one of our office locations 
What to expect during the interview process: 
After we receive your application, we will conduct an initial review of your resume 
If you are selected to move forward, you will take a cognitive assessment and have the opportunity to showcase your interests, skills, and personality by completing a one-way video interview 
Once you complete the assessment and one-way video interview, you will have a final round of live interviews via video conference. These interviews typically include both behavioral and technical questions 
Applications for the internship program are reviewed in phases. Candidates are strongly encouraged to apply as early as possible to be considered in the initial review. Later applications received may still be considered; however, due to the high volume of interest, we cannot guarantee that all applications will be reviewed. 
PIMCO is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive, cognitively diverse environment. 
For more information on PIMCO and Career Opportunities, please visit www.pimco.com/careers/students 
PIMCO follows a total compensation approach when rewarding employees which includes a base salary and a discretionary bonus. Base salary is the fixed component of compensation that is determined by core job responsibilities, relevant experience, internal level, and market factors. The discretionary bonus is used to award performance and therefore is determined by company, business, team, and individual performance.

Hourly Rate: $ 43.26
Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Statement
PIMCO recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, national origin, ancestry, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and expression), age, military or veteran status, disability (physical or mental), any factor prohibited by law, and as such affirms in policy and practice to support and promote the concept of equal employment opportunity and affirmative action, in accordance with all applicable federal, state, provincial and municipal laws. The company also prohibits discrimination on other basis such as medical condition, or marital status under applicable laws.
Applicants with Disabilities
PIMCO is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, including veterans, in job application procedures. If you have any difficulty using our online system due to a disability and you would like to request an accommodation, you may contact us at 949-720-7744 and leave a message. This is a dedicated line designed exclusively to assist job seekers with disabilities to apply online. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

jobs.description_text:
Benefits:
Work-From-Home
Bonus based on performance
Flexible schedule
Opportunity for advancement
Training & development
Join an Established Agency That Values Excellent Customer Service

Are you a licensed insurance professional who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and building lasting client relationships? Are you looking for an agency that offers a part-time, work-from-home schedule where your experience is valued?

Independent Insurance Services Agency is seeking an experienced Licensed Customer Service Representative to join our team team in Troy, MI. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a client-focused role, enjoys delivering outstanding service, and can identify opportunities to strengthen customer relationships through proactive account management.

If you're looking for a stable career with a supportive agency that values professionalism, teamwork, and customer satisfaction, we'd love to hear from you.

This opportunity offers:
Competitive base salary plus performance-based bonus opportunities.
Part-time, work-from-home schedule flexibility.
Supportive team environment that values collaboration and professional growth.
Ongoing training and development opportunities.
Opportunity to build long-term relationships with clients while making a meaningful difference every day.
Career advancement opportunities within the agency.
What You'll Do
As a Licensed Customer Service Representative, you'll be the trusted point of contact for our existing clients, ensuring they receive exceptional service while helping them maintain the right coverage for their evolving needs.

Responsibilities
Market insurance policies
Deliver outstanding customer service by phone, email, and in person.
Assist clients with policy changes, renewals, billing questions, claims support, and coverage inquiries.
Conduct proactive policy reviews to ensure customers have the appropriate protection.
Educate clients on available coverage options, discounts, and policy enhancements.
Identify opportunities for cross-selling and account rounding while maintaining a service-first approach.
Build strong, long-term relationships that promote customer retention and loyalty.
Process policy updates accurately and maintain organized client records.
Collaborate with agency team members to provide an exceptional customer experience.
What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications
Active Property & Casualty Insurance License.
Previous insurance agency experience required (5+ years)
Experience servicing personal lines insurance policies.
Strong understanding of insurance products, coverages, and policy servicing.
Ideal Candidate
Friendly, professional, and customer-focused.
Excellent communication and active listening skills.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
Proactive problem solver who enjoys helping others.
Comfortable using agency management systems and multiple computer applications.
Team-oriented while capable of working independently.
Able to identify customer needs and recommend appropriate coverage solutions when appropriate.

If you're an experienced, licensed insurance professional looking to join a respected independent agency where your knowledge and customer service skills will be valued, this is an outstanding opportunity.

This is a remote position.

Previous experience is not required – we will train you!

jobs.title: Pharmacy Intern
jobs.description_text:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.
Position Summary:
Health is everything. At CVS Health, colleagues are committed to increasing access, lowering costs, and improving quality of care. Millions of times a day, we help people on their path to better health –from advising on prescriptions to helping manage chronic and specialty conditions. As a 3rd year pharmacy intern, you have a significant role in our company working as a part of the pharmacy team– delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients. 
While working as a 3rd year pharmacy intern, under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist, you play a critical role in ensuring a safe and effective Retail Pharmacy work environment that delivers exceptional care to each patient. This includes but is not limited to:
Patient Safety
Pharmacy Professional Practice
Regulatory Requirements
Quality Assurance
Customer Service
Inventory Management
Workflow Management excluding final prescription verification
Primary Roles and Responsibility: 
A key component of the pharmacy intern role is keeping your customers and patients healthy through adoption and management of patient care programs. Additionally, you will:
Lead with Heart – display empathy and compassion for your patients, customers, caregivers, and colleagues on your team
Seek new ways to grow, collaborate with others, and deliver better outcomes
Align others around our purpose to bring your heart to every moment of your health and gain support and commitment
Facilitate a team culture that promotes caring, energy, enthusiasm, and pride
Education:
Accepted into or actively enrolled in an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
Required Qualifications:
Accepted into or actively enrolled in an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
0-3 years relevant work experience
Must possess or be in process of obtaining valid intern and/or technician licensure as required
Strong communication and presentation skills
Complete all required training within state guidelines and required timeframe
Ability to:
Have regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
Lift, scan, and bag items
Finger Dexterity: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
Reach overhead; able to stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
Precision control: able to adjust machines to exact positions
Stoop to a considerable degree and requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
Visual Acuity: Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
Able to orally communicate information and instructions to colleagues and customers
Occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs; exerting up to 20 lbs. of force occasionally and/or up to 10 lbs. of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects
Ability To: 
Have regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
Complete any additional tasks as directed by supervisor or manager
Complete all required training and obtain required licensure (if applicable) within state guidelines
Preferred Qualifications:
Immunization eligibility
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
Once state regulations are met, pharmacy interns should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
Pay Range
The typical pay range for this role is:

$20.00 - $23.75

Whether in our pharmacies or through our health service offerings, we are pioneering a bold new approach to total health care. As health care innovators, we are making quality care affordable, accessible, simple and seamless. We await your fresh ideas, new perspectives, and the unique contributions you will make to our organization.
Great benefits for great people
We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.
This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/16/2026
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

1. Overview
We are seeking experienced music producers, audio engineers, and mixing professionals to contribute to a research project focused on evaluating and improving generative AI music models.

Musicality 
Creativity 
Prompt adherence 
Vocal quality 
Production quality 
Mixing quality 
Overall listening experience

jobs.title: Clinical Development Lead, AI/LLM
locations_derived: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
Role Purpose
We're looking for an exceptional Clinical Development Lead to own the clinical accuracy and safety of every generative AI surface Neko Health builds: the member-facing LLM chat, the Gen AI UX, Doctor Scribe, and Pre-brief. This is a high-impact role for a clinician who knows how to set the quality bar for generative output in a clinical context and then hold it.
You'll lead the LLM and AI pillar within Clinical product and development, partnering directly with the LLM and AI Product Manager and Engineering lead: one clinical lead to one pillar, alongside them rather than shared across them. Their goal is engagement, with members returning, using the chat, and trusting it to help them understand and navigate their health. You own the thing that makes engagement safe to want: clinical quality. A generative surface someone uses ten times a year is only good if it is right every time. You set that bar, and you are the DRI for clinical safety of what these surfaces say.
We're post-Series B and moving quickly, and this area of work is about clinical judgement, evaluation rigour, and strong advisory capabilities.
What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months
Set clinical requirements and the quality bar for all generative AI surfaces, acting as clinical DRI from scoping through rollout.
Build and run the clinical evaluation framework for generative outputs, and define the acceptance threshold behind the >90% eval score.
Own the clinical safety case for member-facing chat: hallucination, unsafe or incorrect advice, and missed escalation.
Validate Doctor Scribe output against the auto-generated debrief and referral-accuracy targets.
Partner with the LLM and Gen AI PM and Engineering lead on the pillar roadmap, validating every release against clinical safety, accuracy and compliance.
Work alongside the Member Experience and Medical Tools clinical leads, plus Quality & Compliance, Learning & Education, Operations and market/clinic leadership, across the product lifecycle.
Carry a small, protected clinical commitment (roughly 0.05–0.1 FTE) to stay grounded in clinic reality.
Minimum Requirements
A practising or recently practising physician with the credibility to set the clinical bar and act as DRI, or an equivalent clinical-scientific background with deep clinical fluency.
Direct experience with LLMs or generative AI in a healthcare or clinical-content setting: building, evaluating, or clinically validating generative outputs.
Strong grasp of the failure modes of generative models in a clinical context (hallucination, unsafe advice, missed escalation) and how to evaluate against them.
Working understanding of medical-device and clinical-software quality and safety obligations (e.g. EU MDR, GCP) as they apply to AI.
Ability to produce and validate specialist clinical content, not only to coordinate others who do.
Comfort operating across Swedish, UK and US clinical contexts, and the judgement to know when to override the tool with clinical reasoning. 
About titles at Neko
We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market‑facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.
Hiring Process
Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.
Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement
Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

Position: Private Equity Associate
Department: Investment Team
Reports To: Managing Director
Employment Status: Full-Time, Exempt
Office Location: Midtown, New York
About Emigrant Capital
Emigrant Capital Corp. (“ECC”) is the private equity division of Emigrant Bank, the nation’s largest single-family owned and operated bank. ECC invests directly from the bank’s balance sheet, bringing broad financial capabilities, operational expertise, and longstanding industry relationships to each of its partnerships. The team brings a unique perspective to the middle market through its permanent capital base and is able to invest with a longer investment horizon independent of traditional fund cycles – allowing it to better support strategic and sustainable value creation opportunities within its portfolio. ECC’s flexibility provides a range of capital solutions that span from traditional majority recapitalization / buyout transactions to structured minority capital solutions that are tailored to the specific needs of founders, families, and management teams. ECC primarily focuses on investments in companies generating between $2 million - $15 million in EBITDA in the business services, industrial technology, and consumer sectors.
About The Role
The Pre-MBA Private Equity Associate will serve as a key member of the investment team and will work across all stages of the investment cycle from preliminary evaluation and due diligence through deal execution as well as value creation and portfolio management. ECC operates as a lean team with a flat organizational structure, so the Associate will gain meaningful exposure to critical aspects of the investment process and have the ability to make an immediate impact on the success of the group.
Job Specific Responsibilities and Duties:
Serve as a key member of the ECC deal team.
Prepare internal and external presentations, reports, and investment memos.
Build and maintain detailed financial models and analysis for potential investment opportunities and existing portfolio companies.
Evaluate prospective investments, including industry, financial and business due diligence.
Interact with third-party advisors including investment bankers, lenders, lawyers and due diligence advisors.
Support value creation initiatives at existing portfolio companies.
Qualifications: 
A bachelor’s degree from a top tier institution
1 - 2 years of related experience (investment banking, private equity, private credit, management consulting, etc.) with meaningful financial modeling background.
Completion of a formal financial training program is a plus.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex, raw data into clean and actionable analysis.
Proficient in financial modeling and the transaction due diligence process.
Exceptional attention to detail and communication skills.
First-rate project management and organizational skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of autonomy.
High integrity individual with relentless work ethic, a high degree of intellectual curiosity, and strong interpersonal skills.
Compensation & Benefits: 
The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $145,000 plus an annual discretionary performance-based bonus. Actual pay may be adjusted based on experience and performance
In addition to cash compensation, the Associate will be eligible for additional benefits including, but not limited to, participation in Emigrant’s health & benefits plan, dental plan, and 401(k) plan with employer match.

Emigrant Savings Bank and its Subsidiaries retains and reserves any and all rights to change, modify, amend, add to or delete from any section of this document as it deems, in its judgment, to be proper.

jobs.description_text:
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer specializing in quantitative trading network architectures and data center engineering. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize worldwide top tier grade, highly reliable network and server infrastructure for a high frequency/quantitative trading environment. You will lead key colocation build-out, migration and decoupling projects, deploy hardware-timestamped packet capture solutions, and build precise performance monitoring systems to deliver a unified, transparent data observability standard across our trading topology. English oral communication skill is fundamental requirement.
Key Responsibilities
Infrastructure Design & Architecture: Design and deploy high-reliability, full-stack network and server infrastructure solutions tailored for quantitative trading operations.
Project Leadership: Lead data center migrations, facilitate business domain architecture decoupling, and execute end-to-end performance tuning projects.
Observability & Performance Monitoring: Build network monitoring, anomaly alerting, and rapid troubleshooting systems. Establish a unified, hardware-timestamp base network capture across complex trading environments.
Exchange Colocation & Connectivity: Oversee exchange colocation (proximity hosting) deployments, manage dedicated point-to-point leased lines, and optimize multicast market data distribution paths.
Qualifications & Technical Requirements
Education & Background
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
3+ years of hands-on data center network engineering experience, ideally within quantitative funds, proprietary trading firms, exchanges, or financial market access vendors.
Network Architecture & Protocol Mastery
Protocol Deep Dive: In-depth understanding of the TCP/IP stack, with precise knowledge of packet/frame structures and state mechanics for Ethernet, IP, TCP, UDP, ICMP, ARP, and IGMP.
Core Routing & Switching: Expert knowledge of enterprise/datacenter network architecture and routing protocols, specifically BGP, OSPF, and PIM.
Multicast Expertise: Extensive hands-on experience with multicast routing (PIM-SM/SSM, IGMP) and high-throughput multicast market data distribution networks.
Hardware Time-stamping Network Capture
Proven experience deploying hardware time-stamping network packet capture (PCAP) infrastructure (e.g., MetaWatch, or dedicated tap aggregators).
Advanced capability in PCAP analysis, microburst identification, nanosecond/microsecond network jitter detection, and end-to-end latency profiling.
Network Automation & Monitoring
Automation: Proficient in Python to develop network automation scripts for batch configuration deployment, state validation, and network device management.
Monitoring Stack: Familiarity with SNMP and monitoring/logging platforms, including Zabbix, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Financial Domain & Colocation Engineering
Exchange Ecosystem: Direct experience with exchange dedicated line (cross-connects/leased circuits) provisioning and exchange colocation (proximity hosting) deployments.
Market Protocols: Sound understanding of market data streams, financial messaging protocols (e.g., FIX, native binary protocols), and colocation rack/cabling/power logistics.
Professional Capabilities
Exceptional organizational and project management skills with extreme attention to technical details.
Clear, professional, and effective verbal and written communication skills in English.

Grow your journalism career with a global media company


Do you love talking to people? Do you pick up the phone instead of sending an email? Are you driven by chasing quotes, building a contacts book, and landing the interview others can’t?


At Key Media, we believe great journalism is built on human connection. AI is transforming how we work—but it’s your curiosity, relationships, and reporting instincts that create truly impactful stories.


This is your opportunity to join a high-performing international media company, working on our market-leading insurance portfolio, covering one of the most dynamic sectors in US business.

Why this role stands out
100% remote (US-based) – work from home with flexible hours
Medical, dental benefits, EAP & 401(k)
Global career opportunities
Industry-leading brands – write for Insurance Business America
Training & growth – editorial coaching + unlimited LinkedIn Learning
Time off that grows with you – extra vacation day each year + paid volunteer day

Work from anywhere – up to 12 weeks per year abroad

About the role
You’ll be reporting for Insurance Business America, a trusted and agenda-setting title read by senior decision-makers across the country.


This is a highly interview-driven role, where you’ll be:
• Writing timely, engaging articles for Insurance Business America
• Producing at least two interview-driven stories and one breaking news story with quotes per day, while booking and conducting interviews efficiently as part of your daily routine

Experience in journalism (insurance or business reporting is a plus)
Strong interviewing skills and confidence speaking with senior stakeholders
A proactive approach—comfortable chasing contacts and uncovering stories

Interest in using AI as a reporting tool to enhance your work
Collaborative, curious, and ambitious mindset

We’re a global B2B media company connecting more than 2.4 million professionals each month across insurance, HR, finance, legal, education, and property.

Real access to decision-makers and market-moving stories

A chance to experiment with new tools and shape the future of journalism
Support from experienced global editors who value quality reporting

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Global Banking & Markets, Electronic Trading
locations_derived: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
What We Do

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don't just make things - we make things
possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve
the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our
engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect
low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats,
and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously
turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a
world of opportunity at the speed of markets.

Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions
in risk management, big data, mobile, and more. We look for creative
collaborators who evolve, adapt to change, and thrive in a fast-paced global
environment. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities?  Start here.

Within our Global Banking & Markets business, Goldman Sachs Electronic Trading
(GSET) has launched an initiative to become the top provider in Electronic US
Listed Options Trading by building superior technology and delivering high
quality products. This vision is a multi-year investment in people, platforms,
and products. Join our team and participate in the development and launch of
best-in-class products for top clients across the industry. 

 

Who We Look For

Our engineers are involved in the entire product life cycle, from working with
users and product managers to determine requirements, collaborating with other
engineers to develop new APIs and UIs, engaging with penetration testers to
ensure security and data protection, to deploying your code to users across the
globe. Our team works with modern Java, and C++ and uses a variety of databases,
caches, and queues to solve specific problems. Within our team, you will have
ample opportunities to be curious, to solve problems for our clients, and
directly impact the success of our business.

We are looking for eager, nimble, and ambitious trading platform developers to
join our growing team of visionaries, and drive Goldman Sachs Electronic Trading
to achieve and exceed our goals.

 

Responsibilities

 * Design, build, and maintain high-performance, yet nimble and adaptive Options
   trading platforms including market data and exchange connectivity for
   internal and external clients.
 * Utilize good understanding of US Options market structure, regulations,
   exchange service offerings and implement changes to these on an on-going
   basis.
 * Communicate with traders, sales, clients, and compliance officers about new
   feature requests, explanation of existing features, etc.

 

Basic Qualifications

 * Bachelor or Master degree in relevant technical fields such as Computer
   Science or Electronic Engineering.
 * Proficiency in either Java or C++.
 * Experience with Linux operating system.
 * 3+ years of relevant work experience.
 * Experience with developing order management system, exchange connectivity or
   market data feed for US Equities or Options markets.
 * Strong communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 * Experience with Event Sourcing (Sequenced core stream) based architecture.
 * Knowledge about JVM internals and tuning for low latency applications.
 * Experience with building C++/Java systems with strict requirements for
   low-latency (microseconds count) and deterministic performance.

 

Salary Range 
The expected base salary for this New York, New York, United States-based
position is $115,000-$180,000. In addition, you may be eligible for a
discretionary bonus if you are an active employee as of fiscal year-end.

Benefits 
Goldman Sachs is committed to providing our people with valuable and competitive
benefits and wellness offerings, as it is a core part of providing a strong
overall employee experience. A summary of these offerings, which are generally
available to active, non-temporary, full-time and part-time US employees who
work at least 20 hours per week, can be found here
[https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/discover/2022-Benefits-Summary-US.pdf].

ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients,
shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a
leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm.
Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world. 

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to
fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond
by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to
grow professionally and personally, from our training and development
opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance
offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and
people at GS.com/careers. 

We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special
needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more:
https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

© The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2026. All rights reserved.

jobs.title: Manager, Regional Technology
locations_derived: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
About:

Bloomingdale’s makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable.
Our mission is to guide and inspire our customers to make style a source of
creative energy in their lives. We will always strive to make Bloomingdale’s
like no other store in the world. Across all brand touchpoints—from
Bloomingdales.com to our newest small store concept, Bloomie’s—everyone plays a
critical role bringing our mission to life. Our inclusive culture promotes
diversity of background, thought and opinion. Regardless of position, we believe
all colleagues have a voice and access to share their thoughts with every level
of leadership. Our colleagues are passionate, driven, entrepreneurial and
collaborative, while having a lot of fun along the way.

Job Overview:

The Regional Technology Manager plays a crucial role in driving the successful
implementation, reliability, and adoption of store technology across a defined
regional area. Acting as a strategic project lead, this role partners directly
with store management to ensure technology initiatives are deployed smoothly and
align with operational needs.

The ideal candidate blends project management skills with strategic technical
thinking. They focus on guiding deployments, leading quality assurance,
resolving high-level escalations, and working one-on-one with stores to maximize
the value of their technology tools through expert guidance and clear
documentation.

Essential Functions:

Regional Project Management & Quality Assurance

 * Manage the regional execution of technology pilots, rollouts, and system
   upgrades, ensuring projects are delivered on time and with minimal disruption
   to store operations.
 * Partner with central IT and store leadership to evaluate store readiness,
   adjusting rollout schedules and pacing as needed to support business
   priorities.
 * Collaborate with central technical teams to execute regional QA, testing, and
   configuration management, ensuring zero-defect deployments and operational
   readiness prior to launch.

Strategic Partnership & Consulting

 * Conduct on-site visits to consult with store management. Review their unique
   operational challenges and provide expert guidance on how to better leverage
   existing systems (e.g., POS, mobile devices, clienteling tools) to hit
   business targets.
 * Act as the strategic bridge between the field and central IT. Synthesize
   regional feedback into actionable insights, advising central teams on
   necessary adjustments to future roadmaps and solutions.

Incident Escalation & Field Coordination

 * Act as the primary project leader during critical technical situations or
   major outages in the region. Guide internal staff and coordinate with vendors
   to determine the most effective correction path, moving beyond scripted
   solutions.
 * Serve as the senior escalation point for complex, recurring issues. Analyze
   the escalation path to identify root causes and implement permanent fixes
   rather than treating symptoms.
 * Serve as the on-site liaison with third-party technicians during major
   hardware/software installations and critical break-fix scenarios, ensuring
   work is completed accurately and to operational standards.

Training & Documentation

 * Create, maintain, and continuously improve training materials, operational
   playbooks, and procedural documentation to support store teams.
 * Drive user adoption by ensuring store teams are properly prepared, supported,
   and trained during major technology transitions. Partner with
   cross-functional stakeholders to ensure documentation always reflects current
   system updates.

Proactive Analysis & Insights

 * Monitor and analyze regional incident data and field feedback to identify
   process gaps and opportunities for improvement.
 * Develop and recommend proactive support strategies to anticipate business
   needs, shifting the region from reactive troubleshooting to preventative
   operations.

Qualifications:

 * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a
   related field.
 * 3–5 years of experience in technology operations, IT project management, or
   retail systems support.
 * Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate deployments,
   manage timelines, and balance priorities across multiple geographic
   locations.
 * Strategic thinker with the ability to translate operational challenges into
   actionable technology adoption plans.
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of conducting
   1-on-1 consultations with store leadership and developing comprehensive
   training materials.
 * Proven experience handling major technology escalations and guiding quality
   assurance (QA) and testing processes.
 * Working knowledge of retail environments, network infrastructure, POS
   systems, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) tools.
 * Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and prioritize tasks effectively in
   a remote or geographically distributed environment.
 * Demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and a proactive mindset in solving
   complex challenges.

Why Join Us:

This is an exciting opportunity for a tech-savvy, solution-driven individual to
make a meaningful impact on store operations. If you are motivated by
innovation, thrive on collaboration, and are excited about the intersection of
retail and technology—we encourage you to apply.

This job description is not all inclusive; additionally, Macy’s, Inc. reserves
the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy’s, Inc. – including
Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s, and Blue Mercury – is an equal opportunity employer,
committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Job Objective: The Taxable Fixed Income Trader and Senior Portfolio Associate will be responsible for trading and managing investment-grade bond portfolios for high-net-worth and institutional clients, with a focus on short- to intermediate-duration strategies. This role requires a strong relative value orientation, and the ability to operate independently within a collaborative, client-focused environment.
Key Responsibilities:
· Manage and execute trades for short to intermediate duration and cash management mandates
· Ongoing monitoring of issuers
· Construct and maintain portfolios aligned with client objectives, risk tolerance, and income needs
· Independently generate alpha-producing buy/sell ideas through relative value and fundamental credit analysis
· Collaborate with internal teams to support client portfolios and reporting
· Participate in select client discussions as needed
Job Requirements
· 5–10 years of relevant experience in taxable fixed income
· 3-5 years of taxable, investment-grade, portfolio management experience
· Ability to analyze investment-grade credits
· Experience working with SMA and high-net-worth clients
· CFA designation or Master’s Degree preferred
· Ability to work independently and exercise sound investment judgment
· Strong communication and organizational skills
The ideal candidate will have extensive trading experience in US Treasury and corporate securities using electronic platforms. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual currently trading/managing money market or cash reserve accounts to expand into portfolio management.
The expected base salary range for this position is $165,000 to $225,000, with a bonus based on individual and firm performance. Total compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and overall contribution.

The actual base compensation offered will be determined by various factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate's relevant years of experience, career progression, qualifications, educational background, certifications or professional licenses, and role-specific skills. Base salary represents one element of Silvercrest’s comprehensive compensation package, which also includes robust benefits and may include incentive-based compensation.

locations_derived: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
RELATIONSHIP DEVELOPMENT CONSULTANT

Burnham Nationwide, Inc.

New York Operating Group –

86 Chambers Street, Suite 203, New York, NY 10007

 

The Consultant, Relationship Development is responsible for generating new business leads, building client relationships, and representing Burnham Nationwide in the marketplace through networking, industry involvement, and stakeholder engagement. This is a front-line relationship development role focused on expanding Burnham's client base by connecting prospective clients with the right project managers and services.

Reports to: Division President

Salary range: $70,000-$85,000 plus commission


ALL DETAILS IN THIS JOB DESCRIPTION ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE, WITH OR WITHOUT NOTICE, DURING THE COURSE OF EMPLOYMENT.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 1. Build and Nurture Client Relationships: Coordinate regular lunches and meetings between stakeholders and project managers; follow up on connections from networking events; create and maintain a contact list of prospective clients.
    
    
 2. Generate New Business Leads: Respond to inbound sales inquiries and schedule appointments with appropriate project managers; pitch services and new products to stakeholders; follow up on internal new business initiatives.
    
    
 3. Represent Burnham Nationwide in the Industry: Participate actively in professional organizations such as AIA, BOMA, and CREW; pursue leadership positions within industry groups; promote Burnham's services and upcoming events to industry contacts.

 

 4. Coordinate and Deliver Presentations and Marketing Content: Coordinate Lunch and Learn presentations with internal teams and manage rehearsal schedules; work with Burnham's marketing vendor to develop client-facing materials; advise on edits and ensure content is ready to present.
    
    
 5. Use CRM and Other Platforms: Maintain leads, contact records, and conversation notes in HubSpot; properly manage prospect files using the appropriate platforms; adhere to required data management and security policies.
    
    

Office/Team-specific Priorities: Your direct supervisor or manager may assign additional goals based on the specific needs of your operating group, team, or project portfolio.

----------------------------------------


CLIPS COMPETENCIES

 1. C - Caring for People: Cooperation. Works effectively with others across levels and teams. Offers help, shares credit, and builds collaborative relationships to achieve shared goals and maintain a positive, respectful workplace.
 2. L - Leading with Innovation: Impact & Influence. Persuades others with clarity, confidence, and respect. Gains buy-in from stakeholders, addresses resistance thoughtfully, and uses authority or diplomacy to build support for shared goals.
 3. I - Improving Productivity: Initiative. Takes proactive steps to improve outcomes. Volunteers for challenges, develops new capabilities, and seizes opportunities without waiting to be asked.
 4. P - Perfecting Customer Service: Consultative Selling. Diagnose customer needs, persuasively recommend comprehensive solutions, build customer rapport, leverage current relationships to develop further opportunities over time.
 5. s - Special Experience: Communications. Conveys ideas clearly and respectfully across formats. Listens well, confirms understanding, and tailors messages to fit audience, context, and objective.


ROLE-SPECIFIC COMPETENCIES

 6. Sales Skills: Builds lasting customer relationships through effective outreach, solution-focused messaging, and persistence. Meets goals and manages records with professionalism.
 7. Achievement Focus: Sets ambitious goals and follows through with persistence, resourcefulness, and a commitment to high standards, even when facing setbacks or competing priorities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

 * Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
 * Bachelor's or higher in marketing, communications, or business ideal but not required
 * Sales, client service, or business development experience


ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

Some qualifications can be developed on the job based on equivalent/similar experience.

 * Language Ability: Read, analyze, and interpret business, professional, technical, and governmental documents. Write reports and business correspondence. Effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, customers, and the public.
 * Mathematical Ability: Apply basic arithmetic and geometry.
 * Reasoning Ability: Apply logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
 * Computer Skills:
   * Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) / Google Applications
   * Proficient in HubSpot, Box.com, and presentation software (e.g., PowerPoint, Google Slides)
 * Certificates and Licenses:
   * No specific certifications required; relevant sales or marketing certifications a plus but not required


POSITION DETAILS

Full-time, Salaried Position (exempt position, ineligible for overtime).

5 days in the office per week, as stipulated by your office or supervisor.

Limited domestic travel for occasional client meetings and work events; occasional evening networking events and industry functions may also be required.

 * Dress code: In-office dress is business casual with provided uniform shirts, and we require uniform shirts when customer-facing. Other dress code requirements may be stipulated by your office or supervisor.
 * Work environment: Our offices are climate-controlled, open-office concepts, with casual noise and flexible seating. Some on-site visits of clients at job sites may be necessary, where work environment conditions may vary.
 * Physical demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers, talk, and hear; occasionally required to stand and walk. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
 * Affirmative Action Plan (AAP) / Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO): Burnham Nationwide, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and makes all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Energy and Sustainability Analytics Manager, Brooklyn Army Terminal
jobs.organization: New York City Economic Development Corporation
locations_derived: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
Our Vision: To make New York City the global model for inclusive innovation and economic growth, fueled by the City’s diverse people and businesses. 
Our Mission: Creating a vibrant, inclusive, and globally competitive economy for all New Yorkers. 
NYCEDC’s Asset Management division oversees the strategy and stewardship of a diverse portfolio of conventional and non-traditional assets across all five boroughs. This portfolio includes commercial real estate, transportation and port assets, critical infrastructure, energy assets, public markets, and industrial campuses. As a mission-driven organization, NYCEDC evaluates asset performance not only through economic returns, but also through broader public benefits, including job creation, equitable neighborhood growth, and long-term community value. The division organizes its assets across multiple portfolios to support effective planning, operations, investment, and performance management. 
Position Overview: The Energy and Sustainability Analytics Manager (Internally referred to as an Assistant Vice President (AVP)) sits within Asset Management’s Energy Team, which oversees the development and execution of NYCEDC’s portfolio-wide strategy. The AVP will lead energy management and decarbonization efforts at the Brooklyn Army Terminal (BAT)—an almost 4.5 million sq ft industrial campus managed by NYCEDC. The AVP will work on-site to identify, analyze, and implement energy, water, and process improvements, emphasizing smart systems, digital optimization, and strategic planning. This position bridges technical energy analysis with operational strategy, developing projects that reduce energy use intensity, lower peak demand, improve resiliency, and support long-term compliance with New York City’s decarbonization mandates (LL84, LL87, LL97) and State Climate Leadership and Community Protection Act (CLCPA) goals. 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Energy Management and Analysis 
Develop and execute a comprehensive data-driven energy management plan for BAT, including measurable targets for energy savings, demand reduction, and emissions mitigation, by developing and improving upon current data sources and platforms for informed decision-making. 
Benchmark building performance, identify trends, and predict savings opportunities through data visualization. 
Track and report progress toward annual savings goals, targeting minimum 1% reduction in annual energy use. 
Project Development and Implementation 
Identify and deliver advanced energy projects, including demand-response enablement, networked lighting, and digital-twin performance monitoring. 
Coordinate with relevant stakeholders, including the New York State Energy Research & Development Authority (NYSERDA), utilities, and consultants to align on project implementation and incentive opportunities. 
Support integration of distributed energy resources, including solar PV, battery energy storage, electric vehicle charging, and thermal energy network infrastructure. 
Operational and Behavioral Optimization 
Develop dashboards and performance reports for building operators and tenants. 
Train staff on data-driven energy optimization and champion tenant engagement programs to drive behavioral efficiency and awareness. 
Reporting and Coordination 
Maintain detailed documentation of all OsEM activities, energy analyses, and implemented measures per NYSERDA requirements. 
Provide quarterly and annual reports to NYCEDC and NYSERDA summarizing activities, cost savings, and emissions reductions. 
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, data science, sustainability, or related field. 
Minimum 5 years’ experience in facility energy management, industrial energy systems, or building performance. 
Demonstrated success implementing energy conservation measures and managing utility data for large, complex facilities. 
Proven experience with building automation systems, metering, and energy-data platforms. 
Effective written and verbal communication with demonstrated ability to engage tenants and present data-driven findings to diverse audiences. 
Proficient in data analysis and quantitative methods; experience with coding and dashboarding tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) 
Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams concurrently and meet deadlines. 
New York City residence is required within 180 days of hire.
Preferred Qualifications:
Master’s degree in related field. 
Professional Engineer (P.E.), Certified Energy Manager (CEM), or Certified Energy Auditor (CEA). 
Working knowledge of Con Edison tariffs, NYSERDA incentive programs, and Local Laws 84/87/97 compliance. 
Demonstrated experience developing or managing distributed energy projects (solar, BESS, EV charging). 
Proficient in energy benchmarking and modeling tools (Energy Star Portfolio Manager, eQuest, EnergyPlus, TRACE, IES, HAP) and Measurement & Verification protocols. 
Salary Range
$115,000—$118,000 USD

We take a comprehensive approach, through four main strategies: strengthen confidence in NYC as a great place to do business; grow innovative sectors, with a focus on equity; build neighborhoods as places to live, learn, work, and play; and deliver sustainable infrastructure for communities and the city’s future economy.

locations_derived: New York, New York, United States
Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description_text:
Crowell & Moring LLP is an international law firm with offices in the United States, Europe, MENA, and Asia that represents clients in litigation and arbitration, regulatory and policy, intellectual property, and transactional and corporate matters. The firm is internationally recognized for representing Fortune 500 companies in high-stakes litigation and government-facing matters, as well as its ongoing commitment to pro bono service and diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Crowell & Moring, exceptional client service begins with exceptional people. We are committed to delivering responsive, high-quality, and professional service to our clients and to one another, while continuously elevating standards of excellence across every aspect of our work.
Job Summary
The Director of Enterprise AI & Automation Solutions is a strategic, execution-focused leader responsible for advancing the organization’s AI capabilities across the business of law. This role defines and executes the enterprise AI strategy, identifies high-value business use cases, establishes governance and responsible AI practices, and partners across functions to scale solutions that deliver measurable business impact. The position requires deep expertise in AI, machine learning, data platforms, and enterprise architecture, paired with strong business acumen, stakeholder leadership, and program delivery experience. The Director manages a team and works closely with business functional leaders, professional staff, attorneys, paralegals, the Innovation department, and firm leadership to strategically integrate AI and automation technologies that improve operational efficiency. The ideal candidate is an experienced legal technology professional with broad expertise in AI and automation, law firm project management, and leadership of strategic technology initiatives.
Job Responsibilities
Define and lead the company’s enterprise AI vision, roadmap, and operating model aligned to business strategy, including the design, piloting and implementation plan.
Identify, prioritize, and evaluate AI and automation use cases across functions such as operations, finance, HR and marketing.
Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows and ensure solutions deliver measurable outcomes.
Build a multi-year AI transformation plan that balances innovation, risk management, and value realization.
Stay current on AI, generative AI, automation, and emerging technologies to inform enterprise adoption decisions.
Oversee vendor evaluation and management for AI platforms, tools, and strategic partnerships.
Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Information Governance and Information Security to establish enterprise-wide AI governance, including model lifecycle management, oversight, controls, ethical standards and policy development.
Develop responsible AI principles and guardrails for fairness, transparency, explainability, and human oversight.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on AI and workplace efficiency opportunities, risks, investments, and strategic priorities.
Collaborate with business leaders to define success metrics, business cases, and implementation plans for AI and workplace efficiency initiatives.
Lead and mentor a high-performing team of AI, data, and technology professionals.
Build organizational AI fluency through training, communication, and change management initiatives.
Define KPIs and success metrics for AI programs, including efficiency gains, cost savings, revenue impact, risk reduction, and user adoption.
Monitor performance of deployed AI solutions and continuously optimize for business value and model effectiveness.
Create executive-level reporting on enterprise AI and workplace efficiency portfolio performance, roadmap progress, and ROI.
Develop the budget and financial forecast for the AI and productivity toolset.
Build relationships with members of the Professional Staff Leadership group to support alignment of their strategic objectives and efficiency initiatives supporting their groups.
Lead the Enterprise AI and Productivity Solutions team to deliver innovative solutions tied to real-world challenges, using human-centered design methods to design and implement solutions including ideation workshops, user interviews, journey mapping, process mapping, and rapid prototyping.
Oversee the Enterprise AI & Productivity Solutions third-party vendor relationships, in collaboration with the relevant SME(s) and Harbor procurement group, including with respect to feature requests, usage metrics, and change management strategies.
Define ‘build vs. buy vs. partner’ AI infrastructure and framework.
Manage strategic alliances with hyperscalers and frontier-model providers.
Lead initiatives for attorneys, paralegals, and professional staff on AI and other technology best practices, including developing and championing key design deliverables, service blueprints, process flows, wireframes, business model canvasses and best practice/implementation playbooks. Work closely with Business Functional Heads and their teams, Practice Support, Practice Management, and other administrative departments to ensure high-level competency in AI across our business services teams.
Regularly evaluate and report on the ROI, roadblocks, and opportunities of AI and productivity solutions across the firm, combining qualitative and quantitative data to tell compelling narratives and shape solutions.
Partner with the Information Technology, Practice Technology, and General Counsel teams to facilitate a consistent and coherent approach to ensuring compliance with legal, ethical, and firm policy requirements regarding the firm’s use of AI and other innovative technologies.
Bridge silos with respect to the firm’s management of innovation solutions and other technologies, across both administrative and legal departments.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Expert-level knowledge of legal innovation and legal technology ecosystem, including the benefits and risks of generative AI.
Strategy experience with modern LLM’s, agentic systems and legal platforms.
Tech savvy, with strong knowledge of relevant industry platforms, solutions and tools and best practices in legal operations, including familiarity with artificial intelligence and its potential.
Demonstrated ability to apply technology solutions to solve business problems.
Deep understanding of law firm compliance obligations, including ethical obligations relating to the implementation of AI solutions.
Ability to provide quality client service to both internal and external clients. Involves the use of considerable tact, discretion, and persuasion in gaining the cooperation of others.
Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both orally and in writing, with both technical staff and vendors, and non-technical parties such as attorneys, secretaries, and clients
Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret information from a variety of sources, apply critical and creative thinking to develop solutions to complex problems.
Ability to motivate others and build effective, cooperative work teams, fostering an environment in which teamwork and interdependent thinking are encouraged and reinforced.
5+ years leading enterprise-scale AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, or automation initiatives.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing AI strategy in a complex enterprise environment.
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, generative AI, data platforms, cloud technologies, APIs, and enterprise systems integration.
Experience building governance frameworks for AI, data, or analytics programs.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders.
Experience managing budgets, vendors, roadmaps, and multi-workstream programs.
Education
The position requires a Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. 
Experience
This position requires a minimum of ten (10) years of progressively responsible legal technology experience specific to technology adoption that includes demonstrated management experience. Law firm experience preferred.
Pay Range
DC: $195,000-$290,000
NY: $220,000-$320,000
Our Firm is committed to fair and equitable compensation practice in accordance with applicable laws. Additional compensation may include a discretionary bonus. The salary for this position may vary based on location, market data, an applicant’s skills and prior experience, certain degrees and certifications, and other factors.
Crowell & Moring LLP offers a competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. Our benefits include healthcare, vision, dental, retirement, and all-purpose leave and progressive options such as back up childcare, wellness programs, cultural events and social activities. We take great pride in our positive, friendly culture that rewards hard work and success, at the same time recognizing the importance of family and community service.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Produce Associate
jobs.description_text:
Produce Associate

 

Company Overview:

At NetCost Market, we strive to meet the highest standards. Fresh produce, value for money, and a uniquely positive shopping experience are the foundations on which we operate, bringing the complete shopping experience to the community.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

The Produce Associate supports the Produce Department by ensuring all fruits and vegetables are stocked, rotated, and presented to reflect freshness and abundance. You will assist with receiving deliveries, maintaining cleanliness, and providing exceptional service to customers, contributing to the department’s success and upholding NetCost Market’s mission and values.

• Stock and rotate fresh produce items on shelves, tables, and displays according to company standards
 • Inspect fruits and vegetables for quality and freshness, removing any damaged or expired items
 • Ensure displays are attractive, clean, and organized to reflect abundance and drive sales
 • Label products accurately with correct pricing and signage
 • Receive, unload, and process deliveries promptly and efficiently
 • Maintain cleanliness of the produce prep area, cases, and sales floor
 • Follow food safety and sanitation guidelines to ensure a safe environment
 • Assist customers by answering product questions and locating items
 • Provide outstanding customer service with a helpful, friendly attitude
 • Report inventory needs, damages, or discrepancies to the Produce Manager
 • Support the Produce Manager in merchandising and promotional activities
 • Operate equipment such as produce scales and box cutters safely and efficiently
 • Maintain a professional appearance and follow store policies and procedures
 • Other duties as assigned

Preferred Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent
 • Must be 18 years of age or older
 • Previous retail or produce handling experience preferred but not required
 • Strong communication and customer service skills
 • Able to lift up to 50 lbs. and work on your feet for extended periods
 • Team-oriented with a positive attitude
 • Attention to detail and ability to work independently
 • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
